representation_fit.evidence: Primary object is the entity (product) rendered as a dense grouped table under a two-level division→category tree (screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900: '组织层级' tree with 4 divisions/14 categories/151 products, table grouped by category with per-row '归属路径' crumb). Matches brief shape bundle many/high-hierarchy/high-density; hierarchy defined at source/data.js:22-44 and rendered grouped at source/app.js:139-174.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Batch management dominates the initial screen: checkboxes at every level (master checkbox index.html:65; row/group checkboxes app.js:154,163; tree checkboxes app.js:94,106,117), plus always-visible selection tools '选中全部筛选结果 / 反选（当前视图） / 清空选择' (index.html:53-55, visible top-right in both screenshots); batch op bar appears on selection (index.html:83-94, styles.css:230-234).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged label proxy: page title/subtitle '目录矩阵 · 商品层级管理台' (index.html:6,18), status chips with live counts (both screenshots, app.js:66-75), and scope line '当前层级：全部商品 · 视图内 151 / 151 条' (app.js:196-199, visible in both viewports) make what/where readable at a glance; data is synchronous at load (data.js sets window.CATALOG; app.js:633-636 renders immediately, no loading state).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object is on screen at step 0 (both screenshots show 15+ entity rows). Scoping = 1 click on tree name (app.js:522-527), detail = 1 click opening a drawer (app.js:542-545, index.html:97-103), batch actions = select then fixed bottom bar (app.js:573-576, styles.css:230-234); no routes or modes — single static page per brief.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions preserve context: confirm is a modal over the table (index.html:118-127, app.js:272-286), detail/log are drawers over the same screen (index.html:97-112, app.js:454-458), selection persists across filter/scope changes and out-of-view selections are explicitly disclosed via warning banner (app.js:183-191) and batch-meta note (app.js:216-219); every op is undoable (app.js:417-441).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are proportionate to a high-density manage job: topbar search + log + reset (index.html:21-31), 4 status filter chips (index.html:35, app.js:66-75), tree with expand/collapse (index.html:40-44), 3 selection tools (index.html:52-56), 8-column table. Conditional surfaces (batchbar, drawers, modal, toasts) appear only on demand (index.html:83,97,106,118 all start hidden). Redundant path display (tree, group row, row crumb) directly serves the brief's '状态归属显式' seed (app.js:3-9).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4 of 7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16). Some structure exists — aria-label on master checkbox (index.html:65) and row checkboxes (app.js:163), role=dialog aria-modal on confirm (index.html:119), aria-label on carets/close buttons (app.js:107, index.html:100) — but key controls are non-focusable spans (status chip span role=button app.js:71; clickable .tree-name spans app.js:96,108), and targets are small: 15px checkboxes (styles.css:225-227), 16px tree carets (styles.css:136-139), 11px faint text (styles.css:201,216).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport and all structural receipt checks pass — layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation (measurement-summary.json:11-13); target_invalid false (line 18). However 4 failing checks (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size, measurement-summary.json:13-16) are concrete rework items spanning color tokens, focusable-widget markup, and control sizing.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '批量选择与操作零误伤，状态归属显式' is addressed in both source and UI: tri-state group selection whose checkbox semantics include filter-hidden items with explicit per-category warnings (app.js:78-87, 130-136, 157) and an out-of-view selection banner (app.js:183-191); batch ops run through a rehearsal modal with per-item will/skip/blocked lists, before→after transitions, on-sale protection blocking deletes (app.js:246, 249-269, 288-367) and a per-item ack line for destructive ops (app.js:350); full audit log + one-shot undo (app.js:387-441); permanent per-row path column and status pill (app.js:166-167); design intent mapped to the seed in the code header (app.js:3-9).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast fail (measurement-summary.json:13) — consistent with low-contrast faint text tokens, e.g. --faint #94a3b8 on white used for SKU/counts (styles.css:13, styles.css:201)

a11y.focus_order fail (measurement-summary.json:14) — interactive spans instead of native buttons: status chip span role=button (app.js:71), clickable .tree-name spans (app.js:96,108), with no keyboard handlers beyond Escape (app.js:592)
a11y.target_size fail (measurement-summary.json:15) — 15px checkboxes (styles.css:225-227) and 16px tree carets (styles.css:136-139)
type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json:16) — 11px body text for SKU, tags, group notes (styles.css:192,201,216)
missing_evidence: Only the initial page is captured in screenshots; the batch action bar, confirmation/rehearsal modal, drawers, and post-operation states were assessed from source (app.js:272-441, index.html:83-127) and not visually confirmed
No keyboard or assistive-technology interaction evidence beyond the receipt's a11y check results
scores.overall_note: A single-screen, high-density hierarchy manager that fits the brief's manage × entity-hierarchy cell tightly: a division→category tree plus a category-grouped entity table (both viewports, 151 items), with batch selection pervasive on the initial screen and data ready synchronously at load (data.js; app.js:633-636). The acceptance seed is covered deeply rather than cosmetically — tri-state group checkboxes that disclose filter-hidden members, an out-of-view selection warning, a rehearsal confirm modal with skip/protection/before→after lists, an on-sale delete protection, full audit log with undo, and a permanent per-row ownership path. All three structural receipt checks pass and no layout defects are visible at 1280x860 or 1440x900. The clear weakness is accessibility: 4 of 7 receipt checks fail (contrast, focus order, target size, minimum projected type size), traceable in source to faint 11px text, 15-16px targets, and clickable non-focusable spans — the main rework signal for this package. Model judgment only; no human-preference or task-time data exists in this pilot.
